subject: Post-call: Procurement next steps & MAP for Redwood Inference
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.inference
To: Katherine Ortiz <katherine.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.inference, dev.patel@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Procurement next steps & MAP for Redwood Inference

Hi Katherine — thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we stay aligned on procurement and the commercial path:

Summary from call:
- AcmeCloud is evaluating Redwood for in-product generative features (search augmentation + summarization) for a pilot (50k tokens/day).
- Primary procurement preference: PO issued by Finance (preferred).
- Secondary interest: AWS Marketplace if it simplifies purchasing and billing.

Proposed MAP & timeline (high level):
1) Legal review (ours + yours): target 5-10 business days for standard SaaS MSA + Data Addendum.
2) Security questionnaire (your security team) / evidence exchange: target 7-14 business days depending on scope (SOC 2 docs, SSP excerpt).
3) Finance vendor setup & PO issuance: target 3-7 business days after contract sign, may vary by vendor form.
4) SOW / onboarding plan and pilot kickoff: once PO confirmed (target 1 week after PO).

Next steps I propose from Redwood:
- Attaching our Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx) and a draft SOW for the pilot.
- Marcus (CC) will coordinate contract redlines with our legal lead, Stephanie.
- Dev (CC) will confirm billing/marketplace readiness and any integration notes for AWS Marketplace.

Could you confirm: (a) Finance prefers PO vs card (I heard PO, confirming), (b) whether your procurement requires a vendor form or vendor portal steps, and (c) an internal target date for PO issuance if legal and security stay on the timeline above?

If helpful we can block 30 min next week to walk procurement/security through the MAP.

Thanks - Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive - Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf

From: Katherine Ortiz <katherine.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.inference
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 18:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement next steps & MAP for Redwood Inference

Laura - thanks for the clear summary and MAP. Quick answers from my side:
- Confirmed: Finance prefers a PO. We generally do vendor onboarding + PO for any SaaS over $10k ARR.
- We will need a vendor form (procurement portal) - I will get the form from Finance and share it.
- Security will have a short questionnaire; they typically want SOC 2 report and an SSP excerpt. Timeline estimate from our side: legal 7-10 business days, security questionnaire 7-14 business days depending on follow-ups.

AWS Marketplace is interesting to us if it reduces procurement friction, but we need to check if Marketplace procurement impacts our entitlement/project billing workflow. I'll check with Tom from procurement and get back to you on whether we want to pursue marketplace vs direct PO.

Tentative internal PO target: aiming for week of Mar 15 if legal/security reviews go smoothly. Will update once I have the vendor form.

Best,
Katherine Ortiz
Head of Product Ops - AcmeCloud
katherine.ortiz@acmecloud.com

From: laura.bennett@redwood.inference
To: Katherine Ortiz <katherine.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.inference, dev.patel@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 18:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement next steps & MAP for Redwood Inference

Thanks Katherine - that timeline makes sense and the PO target week of Mar 15 is helpful. A few notes to keep things moving:
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II report and an SSP excerpt; attaching the checklist we typically use to speed security reviews.
- AWS Marketplace: we can support Marketplace listing but it can add a ~2 week onboarding step on our side (account mapping, entitlements). If your procurement is sensitive to timeline, direct PO is often faster.
- Vendor form: happy to fill out any vendor portal fields and provide a W-9 and corporate address.

Proposed follow-up: quick 30-min call next Tue (Mar 2) to review vendor form and confirm whether to pursue Marketplace. Marcus - can you and Dev be available?

Best,
Laura

Attachments: vendor_form_acme.xlsx

From: marcus.lin@redwood.inference
To: laura.bennett@redwood.inference, dev.patel@redwood.inference
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Procurement next steps & MAP for Redwood Inference

Looping in legal to start the MSA review and track key commercial points. Stephanie - please see the MAP and draft SOW attached. High level asks from Acme: PO purchasing route preferred, needs vendor form + SOC 2 evidence.

Key commercial items to confirm for redlines:
- Billing entity and invoice remit address (I'll add below once Finance confirms).
- Standard indemnity/liability terms - Acme typically asks for a modest cap; flag any non-standard requests.
- Data residency/retention clauses - none special called out in discovery but flag if needed.

If you can target an initial redline pass by EOD next Wed (Mar 4) that would keep the PO target (Mar 15) realistic.

Thanks - Marcus

From: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference
To: marcus.lin@redwood.inference, laura.bennett@redwood.inference, dev.patel@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Procurement next steps & MAP for Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context - I'll take the lead on the MSA review. Initial notes:
- We have a standard SaaS MSA + Data Addendum that covers SOC 2/controls language; I'll populate a redline with an options list for liability caps and standard security language.
- Vendor form: please send the Acme vendor portal link and any required fields; I can prepare the W-9 and other attachments for Finance.
- Timeline: I can aim for an initial redline by EOD Wed, Mar 4, assuming no unusual clauses from Acme. If Acme pushes for custom language we should expect +3-5 business days.

I'll attach the draft SOW and highlight commercial terms to confirm before we send to Acme for signature.

- Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Counsel - Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmecloud.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.inference
Cc: Katherine Ortiz <katherine.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement next steps & MAP for Redwood Inference

Laura/Katherine - quick update from Procurement (Finance):
- We received the vendor form and will route it to Vendor Management today.
- Procurement confirms PO path is preferred; aiming to have vendor onboarding complete and a PO issued by week of Mar 15, contingent on legal & security turnaround.
- Marketplace note: Procurement is open to AWS Marketplace but only if it does not change how projects are billed internally. They will flag if Marketplace is acceptable after vendor management completes the form.

Tom Reed
Sr. Procurement Manager - AcmeCloud
